headline: Paramount-Warner Bros. merger to be named Skydance
summary: Paramount's roughly $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery, expected to close around October 6, will be renamed Skydance, CEO David Ellison announced in a social media post.

claims.statement: Paramount's merger with Warner Bros. Discovery will be called Skydance once it completes.

sources.quote: Paramount’s Warner Bros. megamerger will just be called Skydance
Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery to become Skydance
Soon-to-be merged Paramount and Warner Bros. will be known as Skydance going forward
